recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a face, cropped tightly to focus on one eye and the lips, featuring a warm, desaturated color palette and futuristic, rounded typography placed horizontally across the mid-section.
coreVisualRelationships: The eye acts as the primary focal point, balanced by the lips in the lower left.
The typography bridges the gap between the skin texture and the soft-focus hair.
Warm skin tones contrast with the cool, metallic sheen of the text effects.
coreInvariants: Horizontal text placement across the center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is scaled to fill the frame, with the left eye positioned in the upper-left quadrant and the mouth in the lower-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp detail of the eyelashes and iris against the soft skin.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the detailed eye, moves down to the lips, and then follows the horizontal line of text to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame is filled with out-of-focus hair, acting as a textured negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and peach skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and black for the eye makeup and lashes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white/silver for the typographic highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high brightness, creating a dreamy, ethereal quality.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to sepia, peach, and muted gold

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a continuous circular loop
Lowercase 'n' and 'm' with soft, arching shoulders

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated through drop shadows and highlights

treatment.shadow: Soft outer glow and subtle drop shadow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A larger, bold display font paired with a smaller, lighter weight of the same geometric family.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the facial midline

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the circular geometry of the primary text.
Provides the wide, futuristic Y2K feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up portrait of a woman's face, focusing on the left eye and lips. Use soft-focus lighting, warm sepia tones, and a shallow depth of field where the hair on the right is blurred. The skin should have a smooth, airbrushed finish.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply lowercase geometric rounded text horizontally across the center. Use a white-to-light-grey gradient fill with a subtle inner bevel and a soft outer glow to make the letters appear 3D and futuristic.

verificationChecks: Is the eye the sharpest point of focus?
Is the color palette restricted to warm, muted tones?
Does the text have a rounded, futuristic Y2K aesthetic?
Is the crop tight enough to exclude the top of the head and chin?

adjustableVariables: Placement of the horizontal text line
mustRedesign: Specific song titles or artist names
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth skin texture without digital artifacts.
Ensure the text is legible against the skin and hair background.
Verify the eye detail remains crisp despite the overall soft focus.
Confirm the typography maintains a consistent rounded geometry.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine an extreme macro beauty shot with a warm, low-saturation filter and center-aligned, rounded geometric typography featuring a subtle 3D bevel effect.
